method.body: Cotangent harmonic U solve on the refined short-sleeve armhole partition, with fixed cut boundaries. Source scan surface conserved; neckline/hem V calibrated at runtime.
method.collar: Periodic local cross-section PCA for V; existing U and topology retained.
method.encoding: TUV1 magic, Front/Back/Collar records: uint32 vertex count, uint32 FNV-1a position fingerprint, uint16 normalized U (body) or V (collar). Little endian.
method.armholes: Short-sleeve-only eased lower armhole cut, shoulder endpoints fixed. Harmonic body U recalculated for updated partition. Existing sleeve artwork bounds retained.

limitations: Preview mesh is a scanned visual approximation; physical sew-line correspondence is not certified.
Source scan unchanged; sleeve-root panel assignment refined and collar uses a separate preview shell.
Do not use the index-ordered calibration with any other mesh; runtime fingerprints reject it.
